## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 6 août 2026 - 13 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Madsmads01_, 12 oct. 2026, 1/5: "I’ve been trying to reach an actual human being to talk about cancelling my subscription for a week. I keep getting an automated message telling me the I have to cancel through the App Store but on the actual Finch app, they tell you that only the Finch team can handle cancellations and refunds. Why can’t I seem to reach an actual person for customer support. So ridiculous."
            2. _Mr. T-Wrecks_, 13 oct. 2026, 3/5: "I like the app. It has helped me stay focused and productive throughout the day. The only thing that really bothers me is the Shop items. If you’re a Free user, you only get 8 options in Outfit and Furniture to choose from (16 with the free re-roll). But the options are the worst options—they’re typically the most boring/generic options, and they follow the same pattern every time. All the good options require Finch Plus. Why? Free users are earning the same points in the same way as any user on Finch Plus. The items are already behind one “paywall” (in-game currency). Why put them behind two? Additionally, and maybe even more problematic, is that every item has multiple colors and each variation is a separate item. So if you see a hat you want but it’s in a color you don’t want, well, too bad. You’ll have to hope it comes up in the color you want. That is ridiculous. Just have the items and let us pick whatever color we want! The current way is designed to be exploitive—on a self-care app!"
            3. _mysticalgamer666_, 6 août 2026, 4/5: "Makes cleaning and self care fun. The only problems i have with it is that, majority of items are either too expensive, or locked behind Finch Plus. For people like me who can’t afford £50 a year, it makes it somewhat inaccessible."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 1 oct. 2026 - 1 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Clayer Bayer_, 1 oct. 2026, 5/5: "Finch is great! I love their monthly challenges that encourage you to have a little fun or reflect on the good things in life! No intrusive ads or upselling which I really appreciate. Feels very genuine. Also a nice way to connect with friends!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 28 mai 2026 - 11 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, 28 mai 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _Sullivan !!!12345_, 11 oct. 2026, 5/5: "So fun my favorite way to get stuff done one thing it glitches when I try it click to fast"
            3. _epicinsomniac_, 13 août 2026, 5/5: "I’ve just moved into my own place and I have a whole lot of mental issues that tend to get in the way of me hardly looking after myself. I downloaded this when I moved into my own place a few days ago and so far, I’m checking it every day, knocking off goals and getting to actually do more things for myself than I ever have before while also playing with my pet on here. I already love it even though I was truly sceptical at first."
<!--/ir-theme-->
